title: On-demand shader compilation blocking game thread
fix_rationale: The trace shows the GameThread stalled waiting on first-run shader compilation. In packaged builds, pre-cooking shader formats and warmups prevents compiler worker stalls.
evidence_template: {timer} consumed {ms} ms on the GameThread ({share}% of excess time) waiting for shader compilation.

fixes.text: Editor: Allow background shader compilation to finish before capturing performance profiles.
Packaged Build: Ensure all required shader formats and quality permutations are compiled into the cooked global shader cache.
Avoid runtime material parameter changes that force new shader permutations.

verify: Re-capture in a cooked Test or Shipping build and verify that shader compiling scopes disappear.
caveats: Shader compilation spikes during editor playback are normal and do not affect cooked packaged builds.
